descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于开始在线频道的纪要任务。如果需要纪要和字幕，建议把所有功能都启用。

### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。


> 并发限制
> - 同一频道同时只允许一个纪要任务存在。
> - 同一频道可以多次发起开启和停止纪要任务，但是每次TaskId需要不同。
descriptions.en:
### Usage

Use this API to start a summary task for an online channel. If you need both a summary and subtitles, we recommend enabling all features.

### QPS limit

This API has a QPS limit of 10 queries per second per user. Exceeding this limit results in throttling, which can impact your business.

> Concurrency limit
>
> - Only one summary task can run on a channel at a time.
>
> - You can start and stop summary tasks for the same channel, but you must use a unique `TaskId` for each task.
